excerpt: ProofAgent Nano, now in three languages. ProofAgent Nano comes in two versions. Both are 98M-parameter models that run on device, on CPU or GPU, so no text leaves the machine. ProofAgent Nano The English model. #1 on the full English PIIMB test set, ahead of the 36 published models in the comparison and of five frontier LLMs. The detailed results are below. ProofAgent Nano Multilingual AI privacy and safety detection in English, French and Arabic, trained natively in all three. #1 of 37 on the PIIMB leaderboard. ProofAgent Nano Multilingual screens prompts, documents, tool outputs and model responses before they reach an LLM or an AI agent. In one pass it finds personal data, down to the exact words, and flags AI risks such as prompt injection, jailbreaks and data exfiltration. Personal data, AI security and safety, in one pass. Each piece of personal data is tagged with its exact position and type, for example PERSON/FIRST_NAME, GOV_ID/NATIONAL_ID or BANK_FINANCIAL/IBAN, so it can be masked, logged or blocked. Real model output in English, French and Arabic. Every example below is real output from ProofAgent Nano Multilingual. Scores run from 0 (clearly safe) to 1 (clearly a risk). Each risk has its own blocking threshold. English Français العربية · Arabic AI is moving from answering questions to taking action. The first wave of enterprise AI answered questions. The current wave acts. LLMs and AI agents now read company knowledge, work through customer records, retrieve documents and call connected tools on behalf of employees and customers. Traditional applications Store and process data according to predefined workflows. The fields, the flows and the people who can reach them are known in advance. Agentic AI Interprets unstructured content, reasons over it, calls tools and takes actions. Every step is a new place where sensitive data can surface or untrusted instructions can enter: - Prompts and model responses - Retrieved documents and web pages - Agent memory…
